lead: Sambhaji was a king, born on 14 May 1657 in Purandar Fort.
He died on 11 March 1689 in Tulapur at the age of 31.
He has held the office of Chatrapati.
Below you will find a verified overview of Sambhaji: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
